subject: EmbedKit integration: commercial terms, telemetry & support matrix
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara@embedkit.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + technical summary attached

Hi Monica / Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo today — the latency numbers look promising and the team is excited about embedding Redwood's runtime inside EmbedKit. I promised to send a short technical summary and a list of initial commercial asks. See attachments.

Top items we need to validate before we can commit to a pilot: 
- Telemetry & observability: what metrics will be surfaced to us for model-level and token-level usage? Can we get a per-tenant cost breakdown?
- Co-branding & OEM naming: EmbedKit wants the ability to surface the assistant as "EmbedKit Copilot (powered by Redwood)" — any guardrails on product naming?
- Support & SLAs: target response times for P1/P2, escalation path, and whether we can buy a white-label support bundle.
- Data treatment: ability to opt-out of usage telemetry collection, KMS key control, and model caching behavior for privacy-sensitive customers.

Attachments: [Attachment: EmbedKit_technical_summary.pdf (PDF, 620KB)], [Attachment: SLA-request.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)]

Can we get a short commercial checklist from Redwood so we can prepare an internal evaluation? Ideally we want a one-page matrix (cost, branding, telemetry, support, legal constraints) by next Friday.

Best,
Sara Li
Head of Partnerships, EmbedKit
www.embedkit.ai

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + technical summary attached

Hi Sara — great to meet you. Appreciate the clear list. I pulled together a short internal checklist and attached a draft Terms-of-Sale (redwood_embed_tos_draft.docx) to give you a starting point for commercial constraints. High-level responses below: 

- Telemetry & observability: we can provide per-tenant token/latency/cost breakdowns via the Console API and a shared dashboard link for the pilot. We log model usage and errors; by default we keep aggregated telemetry but we can support a telemetry opt-out at the tenant level for customers subject to privacy rules.
- Co-branding & naming: our brand guidelines allow "powered by Redwood" in small text. Full white-labeling (removing Redwood mention entirely) requires an enterprise licensing addendum; we can outline options in the term sheet.
- Support & SLAs: standard Hosted customers get 24x7 paging for P1s with a 1-hour acknowledgement; we have an enterprise white-label support bundle that tightens SLA and includes dedicated TAM.
- Data treatment & keys: we support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private deployments. For Hosted mode, we offer encryption-at-rest and a contractual pledge about not using customer data to train public models.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick internal sync (30m) between EmbedKit product + CloudForge legal and our Commercial + Security leads to align on telemetry & KMS expectations.
2) We'll produce a one-page commercial matrix (cost buckets, redlines to expect) by Friday EOD.

Attaching: redwood_embed_tos_draft.docx (contains branding options and a sample SOW)

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_embed_tos_draft.docx (DOCX, 120KB)]

Monica / team — forwarding our initial legal view. Per Sara's note, CloudForge will handle EmbedKit's redlines for white-label clauses. Attached is a short PDF with points we expect to push (EK-Redwood-term-sheet-v0.3.pdf).

Key asks from legal: 
- Full white-label removal of Redwood branding on customer-facing UI in the EU & US for specific enterprise customers (we expect Redwood to request a brand attribution window or alternate language).
- Data residency carve-outs for EU enterprise customers (need explicit clauses about where logs/aggregate telemetry are stored).
- Explicit prohibition on model fine-tuning using EmbedKit customer content without prior consent; prefer contractual language that excludes training.
- For Hosted mode, require Customer Managed Keys or contractually guaranteed deletion windows; Dedicated/Private models are preferred for sensitive accounts.
